seed: Separate into Layers on a real screenshot. The walk opens a settings pane capture, runs the command on the Background picture, checks every run of text arrived as its own layer with the boxes stacked underneath them, takes the whole thing back with ONE Command Z, puts it back with redo, drags one of the runs clear of where it came from to prove the picture underneath was filled in rather than holed, and finishes by running the command a second time to prove it does not separate the same words twice.

steps.note: the capture as it opens: one locked Background picture and nothing else
the canvas is identical the instant after, so the pill is the only thing that says the command did anything: it names how many runs came out and how many were left in the picture

THE FIRST TEST: the nine runs of text in the capture are now nine layers over the picture, named Text 1 to Text 9 down the page, with the two cards and the two buttons underneath them as Box 1 to Box 4 (separate-boxes-walk checks those), and the canvas looks identical because nothing has moved yet
THE SECOND TEST: ONE press takes back the whole separation, all thirteen layers and the repaired picture together, and leaves the screenshot exactly as it opened

THE THIRD TEST: Text 8 is the word Reset. A double click goes INSIDE the button to pick the word rather than the whole thing, and it has been dragged off its button and down onto the empty page. Its button must still read as a solid rounded grey button with nothing missing where the word was

THE FOURTH TEST: running it a second time on the same picture finds nothing left to take out, so there is no Text 10, no Box 3, and no second repair stacked on the picture. The pill says so rather than the command looking broken
